name.zh: 智能决策与经济研究实验室

brand.zh: 智能 · 决策 · 经济

affiliation.zh: 香港科技大学（广州） · 金融科技学域

hero.zh:
让智能，
理解真实世界的决策。

intro.zh: 我们研究金融与经济中的智能方法：从大模型的学习与推理，到智能体的协作与决策，再到金融市场的建模与实证。研究由香港科技大学（广州）金融科技学域张光助理教授带领。
intro.en: We study intelligence in finance and economics—from how language models learn and reason, to how agents collaborate and decide, to modeling financial markets. Led by Guang Zhang at HKUST(GZ).

title.zh: 大模型：学习与推理
title.en: Learning & reasoning

description.zh: 研究训练数据的选择与混合，评估大模型在商业任务中的推理能力，并诊断记忆、推理与指令遵循中的失误。
description.en: Studying training-data selection and mixing, evaluating business reasoning, and diagnosing failures in memory, reasoning, and instruction following.

title.zh: 智能体：协作与决策
title.en: Agents & decisions

description.zh: 探索知识驱动的多智能体研究流程，以及语言模型在多轮交互、社会情境与经济决策中的行为。
description.en: Exploring knowledge-grounded multi-agent research and language-model behavior in multi-turn interactions, social settings, and economic decisions.

title.zh: 金融：数据与模型
title.en: Markets & models

description.zh: 结合金融计量、随机过程与机器学习，研究金融时间序列、市场事件的传播及实证金融问题。
description.en: Combining financial econometrics, stochastic processes, and machine learning to study time series, market-event propagation, and empirical finance.

title.zh: BizSage：协作式商业研究
title.en: BizSage · collaborative business research

summary.zh: 把章节级知识检索与多智能体协作相结合，从评价反馈中积累研究策略。面向经济与商业研究任务。
summary.en: Combining section-level knowledge retrieval with multi-agent collaboration and reusable strategies learned from evaluation feedback.

title.zh: PRISM：定位大模型幻觉的来源
title.en: PRISM · diagnosing model hallucinations

summary.zh: 从记忆、推理和指令遵循三个阶段诊断模型失误，为理解大模型可靠性提供更细致的评价视角。
summary.en: Diagnosing failures across memory, reasoning, and instruction following to give a more precise picture of language-model reliability.

title.zh: Caught in the Story：多轮对话中的叙事俘获
title.en: Caught in the Story: narrative captivity

summary.zh: 研究语言模型在逐步展开的单方叙事中如何形成判断，以及多轮交互如何影响模型的独立判断。
summary.en: Studying how one-sided narratives shape language-model judgments, and how multi-turn interaction affects independent judgment.

title.zh: FinRipple：理解金融事件的涟漪效应
title.en: FinRipple · tracing market ripple effects

summary.zh: 将动态市场结构与金融理论融入大模型，研究局部事件如何影响相互联系的市场主体。
summary.en: Bringing dynamic market structure and financial theory into language models to study how local events propagate across connected entities.

role.zh: 助理教授 · 金融科技学域

bio.zh: 张光博士任香港科技大学（广州）社会枢纽金融科技学域助理教授，2021 年 5 月获波士顿大学经济学博士学位。研究兴趣包括金融科技、金融计量经济学、机器学习与实证金融。
bio.en: Guang Zhang is an Assistant Professor in the Financial Technology Thrust, Society Hub, at HKUST(GZ). He received his Ph.D. in Economics from Boston University in May 2021. His research interests include FinTech, financial econometrics, machine learning, and empirical finance.
